item.title: Backing up VMware for free with Plakar OSS
item.description: Plakar’s VMware integration, previously only in the Plakar Control Plane, is now available in Plakar OSS: free for registered Plakar users, with encrypted, deduplicated backups of running VMs stored in an open, portable format.
